parameters.name: DCN_TYPE
parameters.help: Use MB1 to pop up a menu of option choices dictating how the decon operators will be designed and applied.

parameters.name: DCN_OPER
parameters.help: Enter operator length(s), in ms, for each design gate (normally just one gate).  Example: 80.0, 120.0, 160.0.

parameters.name: DCN_PRED
parameters.help: Enter operator prediction distances [in mils] for each design gate (normally just one gate).  Example: 35.0,45.0.

parameters.name: wb_option
parameters.help: Select YES to add WB_TIME to the prediction distance.

parameters.name: pred_correction
parameters.help: Enter 'YES', if making a correction for a prediction window that contains only the 'first bounce' peg-leg multiple.

parameters.name: RATIO
parameters.help: Set the ratio of the zero and first peg-leg lags of autocorrelation to this value (0.0 - calc. automatically).

parameters.name: TAPEROPT
parameters.help: Select YES for user specified taper length. Select NO for old default of 1/2 minimum operator length.

parameters.name: TAPERLEN
parameters.help: A taper of this length will be applied to EACH end of the design window prior to autocorrelation (0. for no taper).

parameters.name: DCN_WHTN
parameters.help: Enter 'white noise' levels, in PERCENT, for each design gate (normally just one gate).  Example: 0.1, 0.5.

parameters.name: TWIN_MIN
parameters.help: Kill traces with fewer LIVE samples (or design gate lengths less) than this factor times the operator length.

parameters.name: GATETIME
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select the time gate reference.

parameters.name: db_option
parameters.prompt: Get decon gates from the DATABASE?
parameters.help: Set this to 'NO' if a decon design time gate parameter file was not created interactively. (Enter manually.)

parameters.name: GATENAME
parameters.help: Use Mouse Button 1 to select a decon design gate parameter file from the parameter file menu.

parameters.name: GATENAWB
parameters.prompt: SELECT water relative decon gate file
parameters.help: Use Mouse Button 1 to select a decon design gate parameter file from the parameter file menu.

parameters.name: PRIM_KEY
parameters.prompt: SELECT Primary decon gate header word
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select a header word from the HEADERS menu as the PRIMARY key for specifying decon design gate parms.

parameters.name: SCND_KEY
parameters.prompt: SELECT Secondary decon gate header word
parameters.help: Use MB1 to select another header word as the optional SECONDARY key for specifying decon design gate parameters.

parameters.name: DCN_GATE
parameters.help: Use MB1 to define the time gates in which to design decon operators (example: '1:0:350-2500/1:5280:1200-2800/').

parameters.name: IOUT_OPT
parameters.help: Option to output the filter operator for application to an alternate dataset or for diagnostics.

parameters.name: filter_option
parameters.prompt: Apply a bandpass filter after decon?
parameters.help: A bandpass filter may be applied following the decon application.

parameters.name: FLT_FREQ
parameters.help: Enter four 'corner' frequencies: F1(0%) - F2(100%) - F3(100%) - F4(0%).  Hanning tapers are used for ramps.

parameters.name: remute_option
parameters.help: Trace mutes (such as first break suppression mutes) may be re-applied after decon.
